title: Build the Quiet Proposal Chase Queue Premium Blueprint (private preview)
objective:
Build the Premium Blueprint described in agent-specs/ai-proposal-follow-up-assistant.json. Read that spec, agents/standards.md, and AGENTS.md first.
Create the public guided demo at /blueprints/ai-proposal-follow-up-assistant and the signed-in Premium kit at /blueprints/ai-proposal-follow-up-assistant/kit.
Kit contents: Silence Queue Setup Checklist; Silence Queue Prompt; Week-to-Week Outcome Log Prompt; Silence Threshold and Cadence Worksheet; Outcome Log Template; Follow-up Review Checklist; Fictional Sample Proposal Export; Data and Safety Guidance.
Follow every entry in the spec's constraints list.
Do not commit, push, merge, deploy, or publish.
acceptance_criteria: GET /blueprints/ai-proposal-follow-up-assistant without a session renders a page whose h1 is 'Quiet Proposal Chase Queue', with a visible 'Private preview' label.
The guided demo page's HTML contains a robots meta tag whose content includes 'noindex' and 'nofollow'.
The guided demo page shows the fictional data notice text exactly as specified in guided_demo.fictional_data_notice, above the first demo step.

The guided demo is a six-step stepper. It shows the text 'Step N of 6', a 'Next step' button (absent or disabled on step 6), and a 'Previous step' button (absent or disabled on step 1). Each step has a visible heading.

Step 1 shows a table with exactly 4 data rows whose proposal ids are P-441, P-448, P-430, and P-452 (customers Northgate Clinic, Pell & Co, Harbor Lane, Birchwood). It also shows the as-of date 2026-05-18, silence date 2026-05-13, the minimum $1,000 or 1000, and cadence text containing 'recap', 'check-in', and 'close-the-loop'.

Step 2 shows the exact heading 'SKIP RULES FIRST'. P-448 is SKIPPED with text containing '2026-05-16' and 'silence'. P-430 is SKIPPED with text containing 'declined'. P-452 is SKIPPED with text containing '$400' and '$1,000' or '1000'.

Step 3 lists exactly 1 queued row, P-441 Northgate Clinic. It shows CONFIRMED text containing 'P-441', 'Northgate Clinic', '8400' or '$8,400', '2026-04-27', '21', 'website rebuild', and 'close-the-loop'. It shows the draft text 'Following up on proposal P-441 for $8,400 (website rebuild) sent April 27. Should we keep this open or close it out?'. It shows the text labels 'CONFIRMED', 'AI INTERPRETATION', and 'RECOMMENDED ACTION' as visible words, not as color or icon alone. AI INTERPRETATION contains 'silence does not prove'. It shows the exact sentence 'Do not invent an objection, a competitor, or a deadline.'.

Step 4 shows the P-441 draft. Activating 'Check numbers against the export row' reveals three rows (proposal id, amount, line item), each containing the text 'Matches', and the values P-441, 8400 or $8,400, and website rebuild.

Step 5 shows the fictional outcome log with P-441 still_silent and P-430 declined, and a mock next-week run as of 2026-05-25. The run lists P-430 as skipped with text containing 'declined', and shows 'Logged declined proposals are not chased again.'.

Step 6 contains the exact sentences 'You send it. Nothing is sent automatically.' and 'Do not invent an objection, a competitor, or a deadline.' and a link to /blueprints/ai-proposal-follow-up-assistant/kit whose visible text says sign-in is required and the kit is a private preview.
Every proposal id, customer, amount, sent date, status, last inbound, and line item in the demo matches the guided_demo.sample_input rows and sample_output exactly.
Neither page contains the text 'checkout', 'buy now', 'purchase', 'Buy Premium', '/month', or 'per month'. The only dollar figures are the fictional proposal amounts and the fictional $1,000 minimum.
Neither page contains a percentage, a close-rate figure, an hours-saved figure, or an ROI or savings claim.

The homepage (/) and the site header contain zero links whose href includes '/blueprints/ai-proposal-follow-up-assistant', and /sitemap.xml does not contain '/blueprints/ai-proposal-follow-up-assistant'.
GET /blueprints/ai-proposal-follow-up-assistant/kit without a session redirects to /auth with the query parameter next=/blueprints/ai-proposal-follow-up-assistant/kit.

Quiet Proposal Chase Queue is registered in src/lib/blueprints.ts with id and productSlug 'ai-proposal-follow-up-assistant', title 'Quiet Proposal Chase Queue', access 'premium', href '/blueprints/ai-proposal-follow-up-assistant/kit', purchaseHref '/blueprints/ai-proposal-follow-up-assistant', and badge PREMIUM. It is not added to PAID_PRODUCTS and has no Stripe price.

The kit page calls requireUser('/blueprints/ai-proposal-follow-up-assistant/kit') from src/lib/auth.ts and hasActiveEntitlement(user.id, 'ai-proposal-follow-up-assistant') from src/lib/payments/access.ts. It exports metadata with robots { index: false, follow: false }.

With an authenticated entitled session, the kit page renders h1 'Quiet Proposal Chase Queue Premium Kit' and the exact label text 'Premium · Private preview'. Kit resource and interaction criteria below apply only to this entitled state.

With an authenticated session that has no Quiet Proposal Chase Queue entitlement, the kit page renders h1 'Premium is locked', does not render kit content sections such as #setup-checklist, and does not show a Buy Premium button or a Stripe price.

The kit page shows 8 resource sections with headings matching the kit_contents titles, each with an element id equal to its kit_contents id. A table of contents at the top links to each section with an href of '#<id>'.

The Silence Queue Prompt is shown in a <pre> element and contains these strings: 'SKIP RULES FIRST', 'CONFIRMED', 'AI INTERPRETATION', 'RECOMMENDED ACTION', 'silence_if_sent_before', 'close-the-loop', 'Do not invent', 'Do not send', 'Nothing is sent automatically'.
The Week-to-Week Outcome Log Prompt is shown in a <pre> element and contains: 'outcome log', 'declined', 'still_silent', 'on_hold', 'Do not send', 'Nothing is sent automatically'.

Each prompt has a 'Copy Prompt' button that writes the exact <pre> text to the clipboard and changes its label to 'Copied'. If the clipboard is unavailable, it shows a visible error telling the person to copy manually.

The Silence Threshold and Cadence Worksheet has a visible label 'Silence if sent before (YYYY-MM-DD)' whose default value is '2026-05-13', a visible label 'Owner minimum amount (USD)' whose default value is '1000', a visible label 'Statuses that are never chased (one per line)' whose default value includes 'declined', 'won', and 'on-hold', a visible label 'Cadence ladder' whose default includes '5-11', '12-20', and '21', plus a 'Generate My Silence Rules' button.

With the defaults, the generated rules block contains 'Skip declined, won, and on-hold.', 'Skip amounts below $1000.' or 'Skip amounts below $1,000.', 'Skip proposals sent on or after 2026-05-13.', 'Cadence: 5-11 days recap; 12-20 days check-in; 21+ close-the-loop.', 'Rank by amount, then by days since sent.', 'Drafts may use only proposal id, amount, sent date, and one line item.', 'Do not invent an objection, a competitor, or a deadline.', 'Silence does not prove they will buy or that they said no.', and 'You send it. Nothing is sent automatically.' The block has a Copy button.
If the silence-if-sent-before field is empty or whitespace only, the worksheet shows the error 'Enter a silence date (YYYY-MM-DD).' and generates no rules block.
If the owner-minimum field is empty, whitespace only, or negative, the worksheet shows the error 'Enter a minimum amount of 0 or more.' and generates no rules block.

When 'Statuses that are never chased (one per line)' contains 'declined', 'won', and 'on-hold' on separate lines, the generated rules block contains 'Skip declined; won; on-hold.' or equivalent listing of those three statuses.

The Outcome Log Template shows the columns week_of, proposal, customer, amount, action_taken, outcome, notes. Its 'Copy CSV' button writes text whose first line is 'week_of,proposal,customer,amount,action_taken,outcome,notes' and whose P-430 row contains '2026-05-18', 'P-430', 'Harbor Lane', and 'declined'.

The Follow-up Review Checklist shows 9 checkbox items with visible labels, a progress line 'Checked N of 9', and a 'Reset checklist' button that sets the count back to 0. Progress is not saved beyond the browser session.

The Fictional Sample Proposal Export section is labelled 'Fictional' and its Copy CSV text equals the proposal,customer,amount,sent_date,status,last_inbound,line_item rows and header from guided_demo.sample_input.
The Setup Checklist and the Data and Safety Guidance sections each state that file upload support and data controls in ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini differ by plan, account, and admin settings.
The kit page says that worksheet entries and checklist progress stay in this browser session and are not saved to Atlas.
With an authenticated entitled session, /my-blueprints shows the Quiet Proposal Chase Queue card as Unlocked with an Open Blueprint link to /blueprints/ai-proposal-follow-up-assistant/kit.

With an authenticated session that has no Quiet Proposal Chase Queue entitlement, /my-blueprints shows the Quiet Proposal Chase Queue card as Locked with an Available to purchase link to /blueprints/ai-proposal-follow-up-assistant and no link to the kit.

With an authenticated session, /my-blueprints still shows the free Daily Inbox Starter Kit with Open Starter Kit pointing at /blueprints/daily-inbox-briefing/starter-kit. AI Collections Assistant entitlement, Buy Premium, and checkout behavior are unchanged. Security Readiness Action Pack, Google Ads Performance Coach, Quote Request Assistant, AI Expense Watchdog, No-show Recovery Assistant, Unbilled Work Review Queue, On-brand Reply Review Queue, Stalled Deal Rescue Queue, Next-Pay Labor Check, Shift Coverage vs Demand Check, and Lapsed Customer Return Queue entitlement and locked or unlocked card behavior are unchanged.

At a 393px-wide viewport, neither page scrolls horizontally (document scrollWidth minus clientWidth is 1px or less) on any demo step or kit section. Tables either wrap or scroll inside their own container.

Every interactive control on both pages can be reached with Tab and activated with Enter or Space, and shows a visible focus ring. After 'Next step' or 'Previous step', focus moves to the new step's heading.
Loading both pages produces no unexpected browser console errors or page errors, as judged by the e2e/support/fixtures.ts console filter.

Product implementation files live under app/blueprints/ai-proposal-follow-up-assistant/, components/premium/ai-proposal-follow-up-assistant/, and src/lib/premium/ai-proposal-follow-up-assistant/. The Blueprint registry entry lives in src/lib/blueprints.ts. e2e/ai-proposal-follow-up-assistant/authenticated.spec.ts is the protected acceptance test and must not be weakened, skipped, rewritten, or have assertions removed.

Authenticated QA uses the repository's automatic Playwright session refresh. If the session cannot be refreshed, QA stops with AUTH_SESSION_REFRESH_REQUIRED and that failure is not treated as a product defect.
The guided demo at /blueprints/ai-proposal-follow-up-assistant renders without sign-in on desktop and a phone-sized viewport, uses only fictional data, and says so.
The kit at /blueprints/ai-proposal-follow-up-assistant/kit requires sign-in, is labelled Premium · Private preview, and shows no price, checkout, or purchase claim.
Both pages set robots noindex and are not linked from the homepage, header, or sitemap.
Confirmed facts, AI interpretation, and recommended actions are labelled separately, and every external action stays with the person.
The Daily Inbox Briefing, its Starter Kit, and its tests are unchanged.
